description: This PHP class defines a data model 'ProjectActivityModel' for representing project activity entities within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It uses traits for serialization handling and implements normalization features for API responses. The class constructor initializes the model with a ProjectActivity entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

classes.name: ProjectActivityModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing ProjectActivity entities in the API layer, providing property filtering and attribute configuration.
